project.title: Native existing MFA cryptography
project.goal: Issue/decrypt existing versioned MFA values and verify existing TOTP without Node/Bun
project.scope: R04/R41 runtime crypto only; no challenge/session/recovery/endpoint or actual SQLite handle admission

boundary.responsibility: Injected versioned keyring, bounded source-compatible XChaCha encryption and TOTP
boundary.rationale: Pending MFA lifecycle needs native source-compatible crypto
excludes: MFA challenge, session, enrollment and recovery lifecycle, current-row ownership and replay consumption

action.mfa_crypto.description: Native versioned MFA encryption/decryption and six-digit TOTP

preconditions: Trusted caller binds injected keyring and clock to current workspace; no cryptographic result alone grants identity/session/one-time authority
postconditions: Source-compatible encrypted value/plaintext or highest matching counter; opaque failures and no external writes

authorization.rationale: Cryptographic match is not challenge/session/one-time authority; key history, strict bounded parser and secret handling are explicit
